boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Denver
boards.description: Ten named Denver food destinations with official pages showing late availability; confirm the listed day before leaving campus.

cards.title: Jerusalem Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1890 E Evans Ave, near DU
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering page to check the day’s hours, then plan a pickup or dine-in stop on East Evans Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A DU-area Middle Eastern restaurant with official daily hours listed through 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jerusalem Restaurant lists its address as 1890 E Evans Ave and daily hours of 8:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Sunday–Saturday hours of 8:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m.; verify before going.

cards.title: Pita Fresh & Catering
cards.subtitle: 2075 S University Blvd, near DU
cards.notes: Check whether the applicable late closing time is in effect, then order ahead for pickup from the University Boulevard location.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard restaurant whose official location page lists service as late as 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pita Fresh’s University location page gives the 2075 S University Blvd address and lists 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 2 a.m. closing Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; verify before going.

cards.title: Birdcall Evans
cards.subtitle: 1535 E Evans Ave, near DU
cards.notes: Aim for Thursday through Saturday if you need the latest listed service, and use the restaurant’s order-ahead option before walking over.
cards.short_summary: An Evans Avenue chicken restaurant with midnight hours on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Birdcall lists its Evans location at 1535 E Evans Ave and hours until midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 10:30 a.m.–midnight Thursday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday; verify before going.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on South Downing
cards.subtitle: 2101 S Downing St, Denver
cards.notes: Use the store page to confirm today’s closing time and place a carryout or delivery order rather than relying on general chain hours.
cards.short_summary: A South Downing pizza location listed as open until 1 a.m. on its official store page.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Denver store page identifies the nearby 2101 S Downing St location as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza Denver — 1136 S Colorado Blvd store page
cards.access_notes: The official store page’s nearby-location listing shows 2101 S Downing St open until 1:00 a.m.; check the store page before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on South Colorado
cards.subtitle: 1136 S Colorado Blvd, Denver
cards.notes: Check the specific store page shortly before ordering; its displayed current closing time supports a later pizza pickup or delivery option.
cards.short_summary: A Denver Domino’s location with official page availability shown through 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 1136 S Colorado Blvd in Denver displays the store as open until 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official store page displayed “Today Until 2:00 AM” when checked; hours can vary, so confirm immediately before ordering.

cards.title: Sexy Pizza on South Pearl
cards.subtitle: 1579 S Pearl St, Denver
cards.notes: Treat Friday or Saturday as the latest window, and confirm service before heading to the South Pearl storefront for pickup or a slice.
cards.short_summary: A South Pearl pizza stop whose official locations page lists 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sexy Pizza lists its South Pearl location at 1579 S Pearl St and Friday–Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 1:00 a.m. closing Friday–Saturday and 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; verify before going.

cards.title: Sexy Pizza in Uptown
cards.subtitle: 1660 N Pearl St, Denver
cards.notes: For the latest listed window, check Friday or Saturday hours and confirm whether pickup or delivery works for your route from campus.
cards.short_summary: An Uptown pizza destination with official Friday and Saturday hours until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Sexy Pizza lists its Uptown location at 1660 N Pearl St and Friday–Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 2:00 a.m. closing Friday–Saturday and midnight Sunday–Thursday; verify before going.

cards.title: Pete's Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 1962 E Colfax Ave, Denver
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday overnight schedule for the late option, and review the current page before making a trip across town.
cards.short_summary: A Colfax diner with official Friday and Saturday 24-hour service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Pete’s Kitchen lists 24-hour operation on Friday and Saturday night, with its address at 1962 E Colfax Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 24-hour service Friday and Saturday night; Monday–Thursday service ends at 9 p.m. Confirm before going.

cards.title: Donuts Town
cards.subtitle: 6550 E Evans Ave, Denver
cards.notes: Check the shop’s posted hours, then plan a carryout or delivery run; this is farther east on Evans Avenue than the DU campus.
cards.short_summary: An Evans Avenue donut shop whose official page lists midnight service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Donuts Town lists its 6550 E Evans Ave address and business, carryout, and delivery hours of 5:00 a.m.–midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists midnight closing every day for business, carryout, and delivery; verify before going.

cards.title: Big Daddy's Pizza on West Colfax
cards.subtitle: 4250 W Colfax Ave, Denver
cards.notes: This is a cross-town option, so verify late pickup timing before departure and use the restaurant’s ordering page to check availability.
cards.short_summary: A West Colfax pizza restaurant whose official ordering site lists service until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Daddy’s Pizza lists its West Colfax location at 4250 W Colfax Ave with hours of 11:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Big Daddy's Pizza — official ordering site
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. hours; verify availability and travel arrangements before going.
